services.description: Generate Suno music, lyrics, covers and stems through Ace Data Cloud. Use when the user selects Suno; submit once and retrieve the same task for finished audio.
services.query: Use the Suno skill to create a gentle instrumental piano melody for a sunrise.
services.query_zh: 用 Suno 技能创作一段日出主题的轻柔纯钢琴音乐。
services.expected: Completed audio links after the original task reaches success; a pending preview URL is not a finished song.
services.expected_zh: 原任务明确成功后返回最终音频链接；处理中出现的试听 URL 不等于歌曲已完成。

services.description: Create and edit Seedance videos through Ace Data Cloud from text, images or authorized references. Use when the user selects Seedance; keep one task ID until the video finishes.
services.query: Use the Seedance skill to animate a dancer moving through a misty forest.
services.query_zh: 用 Seedance 技能制作舞者穿过薄雾森林的视频。
services.expected: A final video URL after terminal success on the same task; do not submit a second generation to check progress.
services.expected_zh: 同一任务明确成功后返回最终视频链接；不能再次提交生成来检查进度。

services.description: Generate HappyHorse videos or edit authorized reference video through Ace Data Cloud. Use when the user selects HappyHorse; retrieve the original task until its final video is ready.
services.query: Use the HappyHorse skill to create a five-second cinematic horse scene at sunrise.
services.query_zh: 用 HappyHorse 技能制作五秒的日出骏马电影感画面。
services.expected: A final video URL only after terminal success; a URL alone does not override a pending or failed task.
services.expected_zh: 原任务明确成功后才返回最终视频；出现 URL 不能覆盖处理中或失败状态。

services.display_name: GPT Image by Ace Data Cloud
services.description: Generate and edit GPT Image 2.5 images through Ace Data Cloud with Flare or Sunburst. Use when the user selects GPT Image; return the image or retrieve the original asynchronous task.
services.query: Use the GPT Image skill with gpt-image-2.5-flare to make one clean product image.
services.query_zh: 用 GPT Image 技能和 gpt-image-2.5-flare 生成一张简洁产品图。
services.expected: An image in data[].url for a synchronous result, or the same asynchronous task's successful image result. Never use the unsupported bare gpt-image-2.5 model ID.
services.expected_zh: 同步成功结果从 data[].url 读取图片；异步请求只查询原任务至成功。不要使用不支持的裸模型名 gpt-image-2.5。

services.display_name: Nano Banana by Ace Data Cloud
services.description: Generate or edit Nano Banana images through Ace Data Cloud, including Nano Banana 2.1. Use when the user selects Nano Banana; keep its original task ID for asynchronous results.
services.query: Use the Nano Banana skill to make one watercolor landscape with nano-banana-2.1.
services.query_zh: 用 Nano Banana 技能和 nano-banana-2.1 生成一张水彩风景图。
services.expected: A final image result after service success; asynchronous polling uses id, not a new generation request.
services.expected_zh: 服务明确成功后返回最终图片；异步查询使用 id，不能重新提交生成。
